declarations.name: OmgButton
declarations.description: `<omg-button variant="secondary|primary|ghost|danger" disabled busy>`: the app's button. Primary is ink; there is one per view. A busy button shows a spinner and takes no clicks.

attributes.name: busy
attributes.description: Shows a spinner and takes no clicks.

declarations.name: OmgDisclosure
declarations.description: `<omg-disclosure heading open disabled>`: a plain title row with a leading arrow that shows or hides content. Closing keeps the content mounted and returns focus to the button when focus was inside. Enter and Space use the button's native activation.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the button, without changing the content's state.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Shows the content; closed by default.

members.name: open
members.description: The `open` attribute; setting it does not emit an event.

events.name: omg-toggle
events.description: The person opened or closed the content; bubbles across shadow roots.

declarations.name: OmgCommandButton
declarations.description: `<omg-command-button command input variant concurrent quiet>`: runs one of the plugin's commands, by its manifest id, when clicked. `input` is JSON, or set the `input` property. While it runs, the button is busy and shows the command's progress beside it, and other command buttons wait unless they are `concurrent`. A failure shows beside it unless it is `quiet`, and is its `error` attribute until the next run, so a page that draws the button again can pass it on. Events: `omg-command-start` (cancelable, before it runs), `omg-command-result` with `detail.result`, and `omg-command-error` with `detail.error`, cancelable to show the failure yourself.

attributes.name: busy
attributes.description: Shows a spinner and takes no clicks.

attributes.name: command
attributes.description: The command's id in the manifest.

attributes.name: concurrent
attributes.description: Runs while other command buttons run, and doesn't make them wait.

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: The last run's failure, until the next run.

attributes.name: quiet
attributes.description: Doesn't show a failure beside it.

members.name: input
members.description: The command's input; it takes the place of the attribute.

members.name: run
members.description: Runs the command, as a click does; resolves to its result, or undefined when it didn't run or failed.

events.name: omg-command-error
events.description: The command failed; cancel it to show the failure yourself.

events.name: omg-command-start
events.description: Before it runs; cancel it to not run.

cssParts.name: progress
cssParts.description: The command's progress while it runs.

declarations.name: OmgTable
declarations.description: `<omg-table label>`: a semantic table with stable keyed rows and cells. Text is always inserted as text; a Node cell is slotted without cloning so its state, listeners and plugin styles survive updates. Callers own sorting, loading and actions. Wide tables scroll inside their labelled region.

attributes.name: empty-label
attributes.description: Message with no rows; defaults to No data.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Marks data busy; existing rows remain visible.

members.name: columns
members.description: Unique column keys, headings, optional width and alignment.

type.text: Array<{ key: string; heading: string; align?: "left" | "right"; width?: string }>

members.name: rows
members.description: Unique row keys and cells by column key; Node cells belong to this table while mounted.

type.text: Array<{ key: string; cells: Record<string, string | Node> }>

declarations.name: OmgPagination
declarations.description: `<omg-pagination page pages>`: controlled pagination. It requests a page; the caller updates `page` after success. Pending requests preserve focus.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Navigation accessible name; defaults to Pagination.

attributes.name: next-label
attributes.description: Next button text; defaults to Next.

attributes.name: previous-label
attributes.description: Previous button text; defaults to Previous.

events.name: omg-page-change
events.description: Requested page; no state changes until the caller updates page.

declarations.name: OmgStatus
declarations.description: `<omg-status tone="neutral|good|warning|bad|busy">`: a short state, such as "Running", after a coloured dot, or a spinner while busy. It is a live region, so a change is read out.

slots.description: The state, in a few words.

cssProperties.name: --omg-accent
cssProperties.description: The plugin's brand colour, for the busy spinner.

declarations.name: OmgBanner
declarations.description: `<omg-banner tone="info|good|warning|bad" heading>`: a message across the page, such as a failure and what to do about it. Slots: the message, and `actions`. A `bad` banner is an alert; the others are a status.

cssParts.name: actions
cssParts.description: The buttons' row; hidden when empty.

declarations.name: OmgLog
declarations.description: `<omg-log empty="No lines yet." follow>`: lines of output in the app's monospace type, scrolling past `--omg-log-height` (280px). Its text is its content, or set `text`. With `follow`, it keeps the latest line in view unless the person scrolled up.

attributes.name: empty
attributes.description: What it says with no lines.

attributes.name: follow
attributes.description: Keeps the latest line in view.

cssParts.name: empty
cssParts.description: The text shown with no lines.

cssProperties.name: --omg-log-height
cssProperties.description: How tall it grows before it scrolls.

declarations.name: OmgSteps
declarations.description: `<omg-steps>`: the steps of a flow, numbered in order. Each is an `<omg-step heading state="pending|current|done|error" open>`; a current or failed step shows its content, and `open` shows it in any state. Slots of a step: `summary`, always shown under its heading, and its content.

declarations.name: OmgStep
declarations.description: `<omg-step heading state open>`: one step of an `omg-steps` flow.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Its place in the flow, which `omg-steps` sets.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Shows its content in any state.

slots.description: What the step shows while it is current or failed.

slots.name: summary
slots.description: Always shown under the heading, such as what a finished step did.

cssParts.name: marker
cssParts.description: The number, check or failure mark.

declarations.name: OmgBadge
declarations.description: `<omg-badge tone>`: a short label for what something is or how it stands.

declarations.name: OmgProgress
declarations.description: `<omg-progress value max label>`: how far something has got, or a moving bar while nobody knows yet.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: What is in progress, above the bar and for screen readers.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: How far it has got; without one, the bar just moves.

declarations.name: OmgFilePicker
declarations.description: `<omg-file-picker label accept multiple>`: choose local files or drop them. Selection stays local; callers own validation, persistence and uploads. Accept checks filenames/MIME hints, never file contents. Invalid drops retain the prior selection. Cancelling the native chooser also retains it.

attributes.name: accept
attributes.description: Comma-separated extensions or MIME types, including image/*.

attributes.name: choose-label
attributes.description: Picker action; defaults to Choose files.

attributes.name: drop-label
attributes.description: Drop hint; defaults to or drop files here.

attributes.name: hint
attributes.description: A line under it; an error takes its place.

attributes.name: rejected-label
attributes.description: Rejection feedback; defaults to Check the file type and number of files.

members.name: clear
members.description: Clears selection silently; user clearing emits change.

members.name: files
members.description: A copy of the currently selected local files.

events.name: omg-reject
events.description: Rejected selection; previous files remain available.

cssParts.name: hint
cssParts.description: The hint; hidden when empty or when there is an error.

declarations.name: OmgSlider
declarations.description: `<omg-slider label min max step value>`: a native range with a numeric readout. The browser bounds and steps the value. Input fires while adjusting; change fires when committed. Programmatic changes are silent.

attributes.name: hint
attributes.description: A line under it; an error takes its place.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Current value; defaults to the native range midpoint.

cssParts.name: hint
cssParts.description: The hint; hidden when empty or when there is an error.

declarations.name: OmgRadioGroup
declarations.description: `<omg-radio-group label value>` with `<option>` children: visible choices, optionally explained by each option's `data-description`. Native arrows and Space select; separate groups keep independent selections.

attributes.name: hint
attributes.description: A line under it; an error takes its place.

cssParts.name: hint
cssParts.description: The hint; hidden when empty or when there is an error.

declarations.name: OmgCombobox
declarations.description: `<omg-combobox label value>` with `<option>` children: a searchable choice. Query text never changes the committed value until an enabled option is picked. Closing discards the query. Options can be replaced asynchronously; set `manual-filter` when the caller filters them remotely.

attributes.name: hint

attributes.name: loading

attributes.name: manual-filter

events.name: omg-query
events.description: Search text changed, or a manual-filter list opened; caller owns fetching and stale-result protection.

cssParts.name: hint
cssParts.description: The hint; hidden when empty or when there is an error.

cssParts.name: input
cssParts.description: Combobox input, with active-descendant keyboard navigation.

declarations.name: OmgInput
declarations.description: `<omg-input label value type placeholder hint error>`: one line of text.

attributes.name: hint
attributes.description: A line under it; an error takes its place.

declarations.name: OmgCheckbox
declarations.description: `<omg-checkbox label checked hint>`: a choice that takes effect with the rest of a form, with the box before its label.

attributes.name: hint

cssProperties.name: --omg-accent
cssProperties.description: The plugin's brand colour, for the box when checked.

declarations.name: OmgSelect

declarations.name: OmgSegmented
declarations.description: `<omg-segmented label value hint error disabled>` with `<option>` children: a few choices side by side, all in view. Arrow keys move between them.

attributes.name: hint
attributes.description: A line under it; an error takes its place.

declarations.description: `<omg-page heading description wide>`: the page's column, centred and at most 720px wide, or the panel's whole width when `wide`. Slots: `brand` (a logo before the heading), `actions`, and the page's sections.

declarations.name: OmgSection
declarations.description: `<omg-section heading description>`: a titled group of content. Slots: `actions` beside the heading, and the section's content.

attributes.name: heading

cssParts.name: header
cssParts.description: The titles and actions; hidden when empty.

declarations.name: OmgStack
declarations.description: `<omg-stack direction="row|column" gap="1|2|3|4|6" align justify wrap>`: lays its children out in a row or a column, spaced by the app's steps.

attributes.name: align
attributes.description: How children line up across it.

attributes.name: justify
attributes.description: How children are spread along it.

attributes.name: min

declarations.name: OmgSplit

attributes.name: side

attributes.name: side-width

declarations.name: OmgCard
declarations.description: `<omg-card heading description>`: a raised surface that groups its content.

cssParts.name: header
cssParts.description: The row of the titles and actions; hidden when empty.

declarations.name: OmgList
declarations.description: `<omg-list>`: rows of `omg-list-item`, with a hairline between them.

declarations.name: OmgListItem
declarations.description: `<omg-list-item heading description>`: a row: an icon, a title and a line under it, then a value and buttons at its end.

slots.description: The row's value, at its end.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Buttons at its end, after the value.

slots.name: leading

cssParts.name: actions

cssParts.name: leading

cssParts.name: value
cssParts.description: The value's place; hidden when empty.

declarations.name: OmgDivider
declarations.description: `<omg-divider label>`: a hairline between groups, with an optional label on it.

declarations.name: OmgPath
declarations.description: `<omg-path path>`: a read-only path with a subdued directory and a prominent filename. Narrow rows truncate the start, keeping the filename in view. The full path remains selectable and available through the native title.

attributes.name: path

cssParts.name: name

cssParts.name: path

declarations.name: OmgImage
declarations.description: `<omg-image src file alt ratio fit pixelated checker>`: a picture, on a raised surface until it loads and with a mark when it can't. With `ratio` it fills a frame of that shape; without, it is drawn at its own size, at most as wide as its place.

attributes.name: alt
attributes.description: What it shows, for people who can't see it; leave it empty for a decoration.

attributes.name: checker
attributes.description: Draws a checkerboard behind it, to show where it is transparent.

attributes.name: file
attributes.description: A picture in the project, by its path there, in place of `src`; the plugin needs the `project.files` capability. Set it again to show the file as it is now.

attributes.name: fit
attributes.description: How the picture fills a frame of another shape: whole, or cropped to fill it. Whole by default.

attributes.name: pixelated
attributes.description: Scales pixel art without smoothing it.

attributes.name: ratio
attributes.description: The frame's shape, such as `16/9` or `1`; the picture's own by default.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: The picture's address: a file in the plugin's package, or a `data:` or `blob:` URL.

members.name: complete
members.description: It has loaded, or failed to.

members.name: naturalHeight
members.description: The picture's own height in pixels; 0 until it loads.

members.name: naturalWidth
members.description: The picture's own width in pixels; 0 until it loads.

cssParts.name: broken
cssParts.description: The mark shown when it couldn't load.

cssParts.name: frame
cssParts.description: The surface the picture is drawn on.

cssProperties.name: --omg-image-radius
cssProperties.description: The frame's corners; the app's large radius by default.

declarations.name: OmgTile
declarations.description: `<omg-tile heading description badge src file ratio selected disabled>`: a picture with its name and a line under it, such as an asset in a grid. It is a button: a click on it is the person picking it, and `selected` marks the one picked.

attributes.name: alt
attributes.description: What the picture shows, when the name doesn't say; empty by default.

attributes.name: badge
attributes.description: A few words over the picture's corner, such as a duration.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: A line under the name, such as its size or kind.

attributes.name: file
attributes.description: A picture in the project, as for `omg-image`.

attributes.name: fit
attributes.description: As for `omg-image`; cropped to fill by default.

attributes.name: ratio
attributes.description: The picture's shape, as for `omg-image`; `4/3` by default.

slots.name: media
slots.description: Drawn in place of the picture, such as a video or a canvas.

cssParts.name: description
cssParts.description: The line under the name; hidden when empty.

declarations.name: OmgImagePreview
declarations.description: `<omg-image-preview src file alt>`: an image button that opens the whole picture in a modal. Reuses omg-image loading and omg-dialog focus/closing. It never changes a selection or uploads a file.

attributes.name: close-label

attributes.name: file
attributes.description: A project image; requires project.files and takes precedence over src.

attributes.name: fit

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Trigger's accessible name; defaults to alt or Preview image.

attributes.name: pixelated

attributes.name: ratio
attributes.description: Thumbnail aspect ratio; image's own by default.

cssParts.name: dialog
cssParts.description: The omg-dialog holding the full image.

cssParts.name: image

attributes.name: name

declarations.description: `<omg-dialog heading open>`: custom modal content inside the plugin iframe. Native dialog owns focus trapping and Escape; content remains mounted. Programmatic open changes are silent. Simple host confirmations still use ui.confirm.
